# Complete source-to-receiver journeys

This package includes the native and application receiving carriers so another engineer can inspect and continue the same workflow. They use the retained public sources and clearly identified local derivations. The final browser carrier uses the original application workspace and exercises its real forms and downloads.

## Native source journey

`examples/NATIVE_RECEIVING.py` retains one operation journal, original source bytes and per-generation native results. It parses actual W3C examples, builds snapshots with a declared CSV mapping, validates explicitly selected original shapes, runs SELECT, ASK, CONSTRUCT and DESCRIBE, compares graphs with source impact, and reopens a separately copied receiving edition.

The journal records the exact native engine source identity and pinned dependencies for each newly computed result. Completed original jobs are reopened from their retained result files when the same journey continues.

The full reference identity collection is in `examples/REFERENCE_INPUTS.json` and `reference/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json`. Native output and selected source modules are described in `NATIVE_ENGINE.md`.

The validation finding counts belong to the 498-triple native snapshot. The application and browser journeys use their own smaller source selections and report their own counts.

The native engine loaded source blob 49a749aa661671080e0935f14243523019189b3e, SHA-256 850ea4767e63aa9c91c0f2db4c2dbb6b0b99cd0f4b131392025e26a1ed32c88e. Result identity is captured when the module loads; changing a source file later cannot relabel already executed code.

The official release documents the modular profile under its validation section. The bundle retains those exact files, their upstream blob identities and an explicit composition record. Generated constraint-ID files remain available as separate original sources; they are not silently repaired or substituted for the documented modules.

The selected reference source remains nonconforming; the operator retains and exposes the complete native findings. This is the validation result of that source, not an application failure.

The same journal resumed after executor disconnects and a failed disk allocation. It retained original prepared actions and source bytes throughout. The actual source/mapping submit defect discovered during this journey was fixed by reading the form's ID attribute without colliding with its input named id.

## Run the application journey

Use the same pinned environment as the operator:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -B examples/APP_RECEIVING.py --operation /absolute/private/application-receiving
```

The carrier records its run ID and operation IDs in `STATE.json`. Reusing that same directory continues the original requests. `RESULT.json` is written after native files, independent receiving, conflicting reviews and encrypted cold reopening have completed.

The example recovery passphrase is explicitly public and belongs only to the published-source receiving exercise. An operational workspace requires the operator's own separately held passphrase.

## Preserve an existing journey

Do not delete its original workspace or substitute newly generated source files to resume it. Fix the actual runtime or implementation cause, retain the same operation directory, and continue the original journal. Partial native generations remain available beside their completed continuation.

Installed runtimes and journey outputs belong outside the source package. The portable release contains the full application, engine, guides, carrier source and original upstream references.
